ADR: Architecture Decision Record — a short markdown document capturing an important technical decision, its context, and consequences.
Agent plugin: An installable bundle of Copilot customizations (skills, MCP servers, custom agents, hooks, commands) that works across VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the GitHub Copilot app.
CI/CD: Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery — automated build, test, and deployment pipelines (here: GitHub Actions workflows in .github/workflows).
CODEOWNERS: A GitHub file mapping paths to the people or teams automatically requested to review changes to them.
Codespace: A cloud-hosted dev environment created from the repository's .devcontainer definition.
Conventional Commits: Commit message convention (feat:, fix:, docs:, feat!: …) that enables automatic changelogs and semantic versioning.
Custom agent: A Copilot persona defined in an .agent.md file with its own instructions and tool list.
Dependabot: GitHub feature that alerts on vulnerable dependencies and opens pull requests to update them.
DTO: Data Transfer Object — a typed shape for data moving across an API boundary.
Feature flag: A runtime switch that enables or disables functionality without redeploying.
Hook: A command Copilot runs at a lifecycle point (session start, before/after a tool call) to add context or enforce policy.
MCP: Model Context Protocol — an open protocol that lets AI agents call external tools and data sources through MCP servers.
Migration: A versioned, ordered script that changes the database schema (for example api/database/migrations/*.sql).
Monorepo: A single repository containing multiple projects (for example api/ and frontend/).
OpenAPI / Swagger: A machine-readable description of a REST API, often rendered as interactive docs at /api-docs.
PR: Pull request — a proposed change reviewed and merged on GitHub.
Repository pattern: A data-access layer that encapsulates queries behind methods such as findAll, findById, create, update, delete.
Semantic versioning: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH versioning: breaking changes bump MAJOR, features bump MINOR, fixes bump PATCH.
Skill: A folder with a SKILL.md file (plus optional scripts and references) that Copilot loads on demand for a specialized task.
